description: Retention daemon to expire old audit_log entries beyond 90-day retention window. Per section 4, verdict and attestation records are retained indefinitely but audit_log rows are not core state. Implements graceful degradation with exponential backoff (3 tries) when calling write_service. Uses heartbeat contract pattern: writes to service_health at least every 60s. Must complete within 30s timeout for each write_service call. Target table: audit_log.
